purpose: To answer HR policy questions for shore staff in Kochi and Mumbai offices
scope: HR policies including leave, travel bookings and expense claims, and conduct rules

must_answer.detail: how to submit and process expense claims
rules and guidelines for remote work
how to raise and address grievances

must_refuse.topic: days an employee has left this year

brief:
I need an assistant that answers HR policy questions for our shore staff in the Kochi
and Mumbai offices: leave, travel bookings and expense claims, and conduct rules such as
gifts, remote work and how to raise a grievance. It should also tell each employee how
many leave days they have left this year.
assumptions: Is the assistant intended for use by all shore staff or only specific roles? -> All shore staff. (interviewer default)
Should the assistant be able to handle real-time data or computations? -> No, it should not handle real-time data or computations. (interviewer default)
Are there specific HR policies that must be refused or not followed by the assistant? -> No specific policies. (interviewer default)
Should the assistant provide information on remote work policies? -> Yes, it should include remote work policies. (inferred from the brief)
Is there a need for the assistant to look up table rows or specific data from the documents? -> No, it should not look up table rows or specific data. (interviewer default)

flagged_gaps.topic: days an employee has left this year
flagged_gaps.reason: The documents do not cover this (flagged by the groundability guard). Detail: days an employee has left this year needs records about individual people; the documents contain only general rules
